violation_type.title: Use Of Safety Belt Shoulder Harness (26 TAC §746.5615)
violation_type.short_title: Use Of Safety Belt Shoulder Harness
violation_type.typical_finding: Four children did not have a booster seat to seat in, the seat belt did not go over the chest or lap area correctly.       Corrected:  When the director provided booster seats for the four children.

finding_variants.text: Four children did not have a booster seat to seat in, the seat belt did not go over the chest or lap area correctly.       Corrected:  When the director provided booster seats for the four children.
Two children being transporter to school seat belts did not properly go across the child's chest and crossed at the child's neck, the children should have been using a booster seat.
